Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane and began a left turn at an intersection in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle
was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the intersection. Driver 1 was
operating the vehicle and a Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat. Both occupants were identified at the
scene and confirmed by responding officers as being inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported neck
and back strain and was evaluated by emergency medical personnel before being transported for further care. The
reported injuries are consistent with the type and force of a side impact of this kind. Officers reviewed scene
photographs, which show damage to the driver's side panels and door that generally aligns with the described
collision. No independent witnesses were located, and the account of the event rests on statements from the drivers
and the Passenger. Officers found no indication of prior damage to the vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named
insured on the vehicle's policy, which was confirmed at the scene.
